limitations.note: The rewrite registered `valid_b` but incorrectly gated its assertion on `valid_a`; the required register samples `cnt == 5` even when the sixth input bit is delayed.
Tying `ready_a` high changed the reset and startup handshake, accepting a bit on the first rising edge after reset when the original and reference designs are not yet ready.
The test exercised gaps and reset but expected the rewrite’s behavior, so its passing result could not reveal the incorrect `valid_b` during a stall at count five or the changed `ready_a` at reset.
